scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.js && esbuild src/renderer/app.ts --bundle --platform=browser --outfile=dist/app.js && node scripts/copy-watch.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n MAIN,PRELOAD,RENDERER,ASSETS,ELEC "esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --outfile=dist/main.js --watch" "esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.js --watch" "esbuild src/renderer/app.ts --bundle --platform=browser --outfile=dist/app.js --watch" "node scripts/copy-watch.js" "wait-on dist/main.js dist/preload.js dist/app.js dist/index.html && electron ."
